'''Bang Zoom! Studios''' (formerly '''Bang Zoom! Entertainment''') is a production company and recording studio founded in 1993 by Eric P. Sherman that produces the English [[dub|dubs]] of [[Pokémon animation]] and game projects through their office in {{wp|Burbank, California}}. 

==English projects==
*[[Detective Pikachu (video game)]]
*[[Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer]]
*[[Pokémon Masters EX]]
*[[New Pokémon Snap]]
*[[Pokémon Evolutions]]
*[[Bidoof's Big Stand]]
*[[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]
*[[Detective Pikachu Returns]]

==English voice directors==
*[[Tony Oliver]] ([[Pokémon Evolutions]], [[Bidoof's Big Stand]])
*[[Jamie Mortellaro]] ([[Pokémon Evolutions]] ([[PE01]] - [[PE04]], [[PE06]] - [[PE08]]), [[Detective Pikachu (video game)]])
*[[Kathy Pilon]] ([[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]], [[Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer]], [[Detective Pikachu Returns]], [[Pokémon Masters EX]])
*[[Philip Bache]] ([[New Pokémon Snap]]}
